title: IM HOOKED! What other episodes should I film my reaction for?? #vampi...
transcript: So I'm watching Vampire Diaries for the first time ever, and my friend said I needed to film my reaction to the end of Episode 7, Season 1. And here we are, the Halloween party. What's gonna happen? Terrified for Vicky and Jeremy. Stephen, please come to save them. I love Stephen. Damon terrifies me. Oh, think he's gonna kill him? Stephen, go save the day. Elena, what are you doing? Is she gonna turn Jeremy into a vampire? She's gonna do it. She's licking Jeremy's blood. Oh, no, she's gonna go for it. Oh my God, she's biting his face. Is she gonna turn Elena? Where'd she go? Elena's bleeding. Where's Vicky? No. Ah, she got Elena. Oh my God, Stephen killed her. Oh my God, Stephen killed Vicky, huh? Oh my God. That's it. Oh, good. It was just a commercial break. Thank God HBO doesn't have commercials. Thanks, dad. Do I trust Damon to tell Jeremy the right thing? No, I don't trust Damon ever. He's not even as hot as Stefan. Who's Lexi? Ariel Kebel, my aquamarine queen. I once was an extra in a movie with her. We sat in the bleachers for six hours. Wait, I'm so excited. A new vampire.
classificationReason: Reaction video to an episode of the TV show 'Vampire Diaries' — non-theater content.
